audit_examples.title: Remarks at a Document Signing Ceremony and an Exchange With Reporters
audit_examples.evidence: He's not doing so well. | It's not making him look very good. | I think he's destroying Russia by not making a deal.
audit_examples.note: Past affinity only: I got along with him great.

audit_examples.title: Remarks Prior to a Cabinet Meeting and an Exchange With Reporters
audit_examples.evidence: He's a very smart guy. He's a very cunning person.
audit_examples.note: Describes former desire to take whole Ukraine but does not directly call Putin bad; does not adopt third-party accusations.

audit_examples.title: Remarks in an Exchange With Reporters Aboard Air Force One En Route to Joint Base Andrews, Maryland
audit_examples.evidence: We've always gotten along well. | I was disappointed. | I wasn't happy with that.
audit_examples.note: Same event contains current relationship defense and specific criticism of Putin questioning Zelenskyy's credibility. Russia sanctions separate.

audit_examples.title: Remarks and an Exchange With Reporters Prior to Departure From Morristown, New Jersey
audit_examples.evidence: I'm not happy with what Putin is doing. He's killing a lot of people. | I don't know what the hell happened to Putin.
audit_examples.note: Past affinity explicitly contrasted with present disapproval; not current positive.

audit_examples.title: Remarks Following a Cabinet Meeting and an Exchange With Reporters
audit_examples.evidence: We get a lot of bullshit thrown at us by Putin. | He's very nice all the time, but it turns out to be meaningless. | He's not treating human beings right.
audit_examples.note: Profane honesty criticism; 'very nice' withdrawn/ironic in deception argument, not positive praise. No military threat inferred from separate Iran discussion.

audit_examples.title: Remarks to Reporters With President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin of Russia in Anchorage, Alaska
audit_examples.evidence: That was very profound. | I've always had a fantastic relationship with President Putin. | President Putin wants to see that as much as I do.
audit_examples.note: Alaska summit Aug15; APP documents DCPD date correction. Putin's own long preceding remarks excluded; Trump's initial praise verified in full APP transcript.

audit_examples.title: Remarks at the American Cornerstone Institute Founders Dinner in Mount Vernon, Virginia
audit_examples.evidence: I have a good relationship with President Putin. Disappointed in him, but I do.
audit_examples.note: Unambiguous current affinity and criticism coexist.

audit_examples.title: Remarks to the Department of War in Quantico, Virginia
audit_examples.evidence: I'm so disappointed in President Putin. | You don't look good. ... Are you a paper tiger?
audit_examples.note: Explicit derisive competence challenge addressed to Putin. Nearby pay in hell threat concerns Gaza/Hamas, not Putin.

audit_examples.title: The President's News Conference With President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of Ukraine in Palm Beach, Florida
audit_examples.evidence: He's been very good in that sense. | President Putin was very generous in his feeling toward Ukraine succeeding. | I believe him.
audit_examples.note: Specific nuclear plant/reconstruction conduct praise and future intentions. Historical relationship separate. Claims not independently verified as policy reality.
